answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in spiral, expire in prism, and copper lists each expiry. Anyone running 61 aliases therefore needs 71 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3480 identities would post 3340 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
